company.shortDescription: VetRec is an AI based clinical notes taking software for for veterinarians.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered tool that records and transcribes veterinary consultations to generate clinical notes, including SOAP and discharge summaries.
productsAndServices.name: Vet AI Scribe

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows customization of veterinary medical record templates for different cases and preferences.
productsAndServices.name: Template Builder

productsAndServices.description: An AI-generated summary of a patient's past medical history to prepare veterinarians for consultations.
productsAndServices.name: Records Recap

productsAndServices.description: A chat-based AI agent that assists veterinarians by providing differential diagnoses, dosage calculations, and educational resources.
productsAndServices.name: D.A.V.I.D (Diagnostic Assistant for Veterinary Insights and Differentials)

productsAndServices.description: A feature allowing creation of multiple distinct notes within a single veterinary visit to document different interactions or procedures.
productsAndServices.name: Multi-Note Visits

productsAndServices.description: A feature that records and transcribes phone calls with clients, generating detailed notes from both sides of the conversation.
productsAndServices.name: Phone Call Integration
